name: Dahlia
handling: Deadhead deep and often. Runs to frost.

name: Gaillardia
handling: Deadhead relentlessly. Short-lived perennial, keep its crown dry and open.

name: Scabiosa
handling: Deadhead. Will run into November here.

name: Cosmos
handling: Deadhead. Let a few set seed to self-sow.

name: Sunflowers
handling: Leave heads for birds, or cut when the back turns brown.

name: Echinacea
handling: Leave seedheads standing all winter. Cut in March.

name: Gladiolus
handling: Spike off now, leaves stay until yellow. Corm decision in November.

name: California poppy
handling: Self-sows freely. Leave it to do that.

name: Shirley poppy
handling: Shake pods where wanted, then pull the plants.

name: Oregano
handling: Shear a third off now, dry the leaves. Hard prune in spring.

name: Hardy geranium
handling: Shear to a few inches for fresh foliage and a second flush.

name: Unidentified spike
handling: Handling depends on which. See the open questions.

name: Unidentified pods
handling: Handling depends on which. See the open questions.
